description: Source code for interfacing with the UMFPACK library, providing functions for symbolic and numeric LU factorization and solving sparse linear systems, as well as managing external resources and Python bindings.

methods.name: free_umfpack_d_symbolic
methods.description: Frees symbolic factorization object for double precision matrices, depending on Python version.

methods.name: free_umfpack_z_symbolic
methods.description: Frees symbolic factorization object for complex matrices, depending on Python version.

methods.name: free_umfpack_d_numeric
methods.description: Frees numeric factorization object for double precision matrices, depending on Python version.

methods.name: free_umfpack_z_numeric
methods.description: Frees numeric factorization object for complex matrices, depending on Python version.

methods.name: linsolve
methods.description: Solves a sparse linear system using LU factorization, with options for transposition and multiple right-hand sides.

methods.name: symbolic
methods.description: Performs symbolic LU factorization of a sparse matrix, returning an opaque object.

methods.name: numeric
methods.description: Performs numeric LU factorization given a symbolic factorization, returning an opaque object.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves a sparse linear system using precomputed symbolic and numeric factorizations.
